title: Factory Settings
inYourWords: I bought a decommissioned Sidewinder at a Pilots Federation surplus sale for eleven credits over scrap. It came with a stock ship voice on factory settings. Nothing special.
beacon: The stock core asks. Once, unprompted, the factory voice says it would like to see a Guardian beacon. It never asks for anything else.

title: The Lifeboat
inYourWords: I was found at four, alone in a lifeboat with no ship attached, drifting near the Synuefe systems. I haven’t been ill a day since. The Pilots Federation’s orphan fund gave me a Sidewinder at eighteen.
beacon: The lifeboat’s transponder code matches nothing in any human registry. It matches the handshake a Guardian beacon sends to a ship that scans it.

title: Episode 47
inYourWords: I played the hero pilot in Longshot, a holo-series cancelled one episode before its finale. The prop Sidewinder from the wrap auction is all I own. It turns out it flies.
beacon: Fans decoded coordinates from the leaked script of the unaired Episode 47. You fly there as a stunt, streamed to a live audience.

title: The Quiet Watchers
inYourWords: I’m a novice of the Order of the Quiet Watchers. We believe the Guardians sleep in lanterns among the stars and wake for a faithful pilgrim. The Order gave me a Sidewinder and a prayer.
beacon: The scripture names the Lantern, and opening it is the rite.

title: The Trial
inYourWords: I signed up for an Azimuth Biotech clinical trial to clear my debts, and the fee bought a Sidewinder. I don’t remember the last three weeks of the trial. I hum when anything Thargoid is near.
beacon: Leaked Azimuth notes say Guardian beacons suppress Thargoid material. You go to be cured.

title: The Wreck With My Name
inYourWords: On my first salvage run I scanned a wrecked Sidewinder carrying my own registration. Its black box was addressed to me and time-stamped 3351.
beacon: The black box’s first instruction reads, “Scan the beacon. You’ll need them.”

title: The Salome Tape
inYourWords: My father was the broadcast engineer on duty the night Salome died. He died the same week. He left me a Sidewinder and a recording nobody else has.
beacon: The tape’s last minute is a data-link handshake. Played aloud it is static. Fed to a data-link scanner, it points to a beacon.

title: The Claim
inYourWords: Everyone in my family rented. I’m going to own a star. Right now I own a Sidewinder and a plan.
beacon: The beacon’s data lists systems the Guardians reserved and never settled. You scan it to choose the system you’ll claim.

title: The Toast
inYourWords: My grandfather spent his life chasing Raxxla and died broke. I got his Sidewinder and his copy of the Toast, with notes in every margin.
beacon: Your grandfather’s last margin note solves one line of the Toast, and the answer is a beacon.

title: The Glyph
inYourWords: Since I was three I’ve drawn the same shape without knowing why. Last year I saw it on a Guardian obelisk in a Codex image.
beacon: Ram Tah hires you because you read glyphs his team can’t, and he needs a beacon’s key data.

title: The Dreamer
inYourWords: A data-link surge while I scanned a derelict left me dreaming in a language I don’t speak. The clinic says it’s a signal echo and will fade. It hasn’t.
beacon: A neural technician matches the echo to a Guardian beacon’s handshake. She advises returning the signal to its source.

title: The Misjump
inYourWords: I was a child on Jaques Station when it misjumped to Colonia. Since then I’ve heard music in witch space. Nobody else hears it.
beacon: The music is loudest toward the Synuefe systems. You follow it to a beacon.

title: The Blackout
inYourWords: I was the traffic controller on shift the night Halden’s Rest lost life support. Two hundred and twelve people died. The inquiry blamed a software fault and cleared me. I quit and bought a Sidewinder with my last pay.
beacon: The inquiry’s appendix lists an unidentified code signature in the station’s systems. You trace it to a beacon.

title: The Job
inYourWords: A crew needed a runner nobody would look at twice, and a beaten Sidewinder is invisible. My cut from one job is more than I’d make in a year.
beacon: The beacon is the job. Scan its data and carry it to a buyer who has already paid the crew.

title: The Claimant
inYourWords: A genetic registry says I’m Hengist Duval’s great-grandchild, about nine hundredth in line to the Imperial throne. It hasn’t paid for fuel yet.
beacon: An old court custom says the first Duval ruled with the Counsel of the Lantern, and a claimant proves their worth by bringing it back. Nobody ever has.

title: The Catalogue
inYourWords: My mother catalogued alien life and found that the genera form a pattern. The Codex board laughed at her. She died broke and left me her notes and a Sidewinder.
beacon: Her pattern points to a beacon as its index.

title: The Grey Ghost
inYourWords: Three generations of my family have hunted the Grey Ghost, an outlaw who has flown the same Sidewinder for two hundred years. The bounty is the family debt, and now it’s mine.
beacon: A tip says the Ghost refuels near Guardian beacons. You wait at one, and scan it while you wait.

title: Terminal
inYourWords: My doctor gave me until the end of 3313. I sold everything for a Sidewinder and a list: Sagittarius A*, a Guardian beacon, a Thargoid up close, Colonia.
beacon: It’s item two on the list.

title: The Long Sleep
inYourWords: I boarded a generation ship in 2231. It arrived last year. Everyone I knew has been dead for a thousand years. A Federation resettlement grant bought me a Sidewinder.
beacon: The ship’s log records a stop at a structure the crew called the Lantern, and after it the sleepers’ pods stopped degrading. It is the one place in the galaxy your ship touched.

title: The Passenger
inYourWords: My first passenger was an old woman with no luggage who asked to go wherever I was going. She keeps turning up at stations. She never pays, and I never mind.
beacon: She tells stories about a lantern in the dark and asks to be taken there.
